headings.text: English for Travel Abroad: Airport to Hotel Phrases

paragraphs: From check-in to taxi, the exact English phrases you need on a foreign trip — with replies you will hear.
Travelling abroad is easier with a few fixed phrases. Here is the journey, step by step.
"I have a flight to Dubai." "Here is my passport." "One bag to check in."
"Laptop out, liquids in the bag." You reply: "Sure." Keep answers short.
"Window or aisle?" "Aisle, please." "Chicken or veg?" "Chicken, thank you."
"Purpose of visit?" "Tourism." "How long?" "One week." "Where will you stay?" "Hotel Nova."
"I have a reservation under Patil." "Breakfast included?" "What time is checkout?"
"Where is the hospital?" "Call a doctor, please." "I need help."
Role-play each step on SpeakNow before the trip. You will speak without panic abroad.
